note: Curated free learning resources outside Honest Learn. Every entry must be re-checked by a reviewer (free, no ads aimed at children, age-appropriate, still online) and get a lastChecked date before public launch. Run `node scripts/check-links.mjs` to test that URLs respond.

resources.name: StoryWeaver
resources.description: Thousands of free illustrated storybooks for young readers, in many languages, with read-along options.

resources.name: ScratchJr
resources.description: A free tablet app where young children snap together picture blocks to make characters move, jump and dance.

resources.name: Chrome Music Lab
resources.description: Playful music experiments in the browser: rhythm, melody, sound waves and making your own songs.

resources.name: NASA Space Place
resources.description: NASA's site for kids: space, Earth, weather and the Sun, with games and hands-on activities.

resources.name: Be Internet Awesome
resources.description: Online-safety lessons and the Interland game: privacy, scams, kindness and spotting fakes.

resources.name: KidsHealth (Nemours)
resources.description: Doctor-reviewed health information with separate sections for kids, teens and parents.

resources.name: Khan Academy
resources.description: Free practice and video lessons from early math to calculus, science, economics and more. Non-profit, no ads.

resources.name: Code.org
resources.description: Free coding courses and Hour of Code activities, from block coding to JavaScript.

resources.name: Scratch
resources.description: Make games, stories and animations with block code. Made by the MIT Media Lab.

resources.name: PhET Interactive Simulations
resources.description: Free interactive science and math simulations from the University of Colorado Boulder.

resources.name: Simple English Wikipedia
resources.description: Wikipedia written in simpler English. Good for checking facts and reading more.

resources.name: Open Library
resources.description: Borrow and read many books online for free, run by the non-profit Internet Archive.

resources.name: Google Earth
resources.description: Explore the planet in 3D: countries, mountains, oceans and cities.

resources.name: Google Arts & Culture
resources.description: Artworks and stories from museums and cultural organisations around the world.

resources.name: Desmos Graphing Calculator
resources.description: A free online graphing calculator. Type an equation and see its graph instantly.

resources.name: GeoGebra
resources.description: Free interactive tools for geometry, algebra, graphing and statistics.

resources.name: BBC Bitesize
resources.description: Free study guides, videos and quizzes for school subjects (follows the UK curriculum).

resources.name: CK-12
resources.description: Free online textbooks, practice and simulations for math and science.

resources.name: OpenStax
resources.description: Free, peer-reviewed textbooks from Rice University: algebra, statistics, biology, physics, economics and more.

resources.name: Project Gutenberg
resources.description: Over 70,000 free classic books whose copyright has expired.

resources.name: Our World in Data
resources.description: Charts and research on the world's biggest problems: health, poverty, climate, education.

resources.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
resources.description: Free lecture notes, exams and videos from real MIT courses. A taste of university study.

resources.name: freeCodeCamp
resources.description: Free, self-paced coding curriculum with certifications in web development and more.

resources.name: Practical Money Skills
resources.description: Free money-management lessons and games about budgeting, saving and credit.

resources.name: Investor.gov (US SEC)
resources.description: Plain-language guides to investing basics and spotting investment fraud (US-focused, useful everywhere).

resources.name: My Next Move
resources.description: Explore careers by interest, with skills, tasks and education needed (US-focused).

resources.name: Wikipedia
resources.description: The free encyclopedia. Great for overviews. Always check the sources at the bottom of each article.
